title: Kathryn Had a Little Too Much Vodka
description:
When New Jersey officers pulled over a car for dark tints, they had no clue what surprise they were in for. What happened next would shock officers, prompting them to abandon one traffic stop and pursue another suspect — later identified as Kathryn Ziola. The 74-year-old would later plead guilty to DUI in connection to this incident. Watch the chaos unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
